description: Registry of the four elements audited by docs/modularity.md. Pins are recorded evidence: every ref string appears verbatim in the cited source file in this checkout (enforced by tests/test_modularity_spec.py). Cross-repo module and endpoint names are cited from the workflow chapters that were written against those trees; the element repositories are not checked out in this workspace.
dependency_direction: points down: workflow (protocol) <- bundlebees (execution) <- orbitdesktop (control surface); hyvv sits beside the executor as the worker host and is consumed by it

workflow.role: normative protocol: specifications, authority, handoffs, evidence, acceptance; schemas, validators, acdd-lint, project-state checker, reference demo, cold-start acceptance harness. No state, no execution.
optional_integrations: bundlebees loads its validators from a pinned checkout of this repo

pins.what: base revision audited by this modularity spec
feature-packet line (PR 33) pinned by bundlebees CI as WORKFLOW_SRC

hyvv.role: worker host. Owns the versioned /v1 worker API (attempts) and governed provisioning; owns its host filesystem. Extracted from the PC launcher.
optional_integrations: bundlebees dispatches attempts over its /v1 API
parking-state refusal is a proposal in hyvv PR 1, not running code

pins.what: feat/worker-provisioning branch (PR 4 open): governed provisioning endpoints

bundlebees.role: execution system (Hermes plugin): dispatch, strict briefs, HMAC file leases, sandboxed verify, integrate, durable job store, reconciler, queue, bounded recovery, RETURN packets, agent wake-up.
optional_integrations: orbitdesktop launcher front-end (orbit-loopback adapter is the default worker backend)
opencode and codex backends are fail-closed stubs

pins.what: main: autonomy milestones M1 through M4.3 (PRs 16-19)

orbitdesktop.role: coordination interface: collaboration boards, agent sessions (Grok Bots, Hermes, Pi, others), activity view, local-workers launcher adapter.
optional_integrations: local-workers adapter turns board tasks into launcher attempts against bundlebees
planned ACDD evidence view reads bundlebees artifacts

pins.what: Orbit commit pinned by the bundlebees orbit-roundtrip job
Orbit commit pinned by the bundlebees orbit-roundtrip job

notes: bundlebees main runs its mandatory suite only with both pinned checkouts present (REQUIRE_WORKFLOW and REQUIRE_HYVV fail closed); the offline acceptance harness can instead drive verify with a scripted worker backend.
The hyvv provisioning endpoints live on the pinned branch, not on a merged mainline, as of the audited revision.
orbitdesktop main was reconciled with the live tree on Nov 12 (PR 24); the runnable-by-anyone first-run path is in progress, not landed.
